title: types, components, console: spec 18 refuses the page kind `jsx` (objectstack#23543 F5-jsx) — move the console sample to `html`, then drop the `'jsx'` member of `PageNodeSchema.kind` and the page renderer's `'jsx'` branch
body:
Filing gate **④, a cross-repo child**: the objectui layer of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23543 family F5-jsx. That family landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638 (`c5dd7fce30`, merged 2026-10-15T09:48Z).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638

- **Filed by:** objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk`. This seat accepted that PR, so it files the consumer follow-up (cross-repo coordination, rule 3).
- **Who acts:** the objectui seat that triage routes this card to. Its dev makes one PR here. The grade and the route are triage's.
- **Why a new card:** the maintainer's ruling put the console sample's move "on objectui#12334" (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23543, comment `6182001882`, item 5). #12334 closed on 2026-10-15T01:40Z without it, and no open objectui card carries it.
- **Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` in objectui, closed included:
  - `jsx page kind html 23543`: 6 hits, all closed, none this card. The nearest are #5469 (the ADR-0080 styling-retraction prose) and #7006 (`react-pages.md`).
  - `jsx is:open`: 0 hits.
  - `page kind jsx retired html console sample spec 18 consumer follow-up`: 16 hits, none this card.

## What spec 18 changed

The ruling, verbatim:

> 5. **F5-jsx A:** `'jsx'` retires from `PageSchema.kind` through `enumWithRetiredValues` naming `html`, together with the `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` branch; the entry retires; objectui's console sample moves to `html` (one line, on objectui#12334).

From the landed changeset (`.changeset/23543-f5-jsx-retire-page-kind-jsx.md`):

- An authored `kind: 'jsx'` is refused at parse, with a prescription naming `html`. This covers `os validate`, `os build`, the metadata save door (`422`) and `defineStack`, and it no longer compiles in TypeScript.
- Stored metadata needs no edit. Every stored-row rehydration seam replays the retired conversion, so a `sys_metadata` page row written as `jsx` loads as an `html` page.

The spec contract door is `PageSchema.kind` in `@objectstack/spec` 18.

## The objectui sites (`main` at `cf430cd10`)

1. `apps/console/src/sdui-jsx-preview.tsx:87`: `const page = { type: 'home', kind: 'jsx', … }` becomes `kind: 'html'`. This is the ruling's one line. The header comment (lines 1 and 15) names the jsx tier and moves with it.
2. `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1795`, `PageNodeSchema.kind`: `kind?: 'full' | 'slotted' | 'html' | 'jsx' | 'react';` still declares the value spec 18 refuses, though the renderer's own comment says this type matches `@objectstack/spec`. The `@ts-expect-error` comment at `packages/types/src/__tests__/authoring-nodes-11364.test.ts:181` lists `jsx` among the spec's modes and moves with it.
3. `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:682`: `if (kind === 'html' || kind === 'jsx')` keeps a consumer-side tolerance, and the comment at `:673`–`:675` calls `'jsx'` "a deprecated alias".

Sites 2 and 3 are not named by the ruling's one line. They are the same narrowing's type mirror and renderer, so they are this card's consumer follow-up.

`packages/types/src/zod/` carries no `'jsx'` page kind (measured at `cf430cd10`), so there is no zod mirror to change.

**Pin reading at dispatch:** `packages/types` pins `@objectstack/spec` `^18.0.0-next.1`, and `c5dd7fce30` is in no published spec release yet. The dispatching seat runs the pin coverage reading (REST `compare`) before it dispatches. If the pin does not cover `c5dd7fce30`, the PR body records the window.

**Done when:** none of the sites above reads or writes the page kind `'jsx'`, and the console preview renders as `html` exactly as it does today as `jsx`.
